question: 看一下 2026 年 6 月 Belli Welli 销售额、销量和订单数
expected_sql: SELECT to_char(report_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, SUM(ordered_revenue) AS order_revenue, SUM(ordered_units) AS units, SUM(order_items) AS order_items FROM intermediate_amazon_3p_orders_belliwelli_view WHERE report_date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND report_date < DATE '2026-07-01' AND country_code = 'US' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

question: 看一下 2026 年 5 月 Inner brightness 每天的订单销售额、销量和订单数

question: 按 Business Report 看 2026 年 5 月 Inner brightness 销售额最高的 ASIN，并带 sessions 和转化率
expected_sql: SELECT asin, SUM(salesbyasin_orderedproductsales_amount) AS sales, SUM(salesbyasin_unitsordered) AS units, SUM(trafficbyasin_sessions) AS sessions, ROUND((SUM(salesbyasin_unitsordered) / NULLIF(SUM(trafficbyasin_sessions), 0))::numeric, 4) AS unit_session_rate FROM intermediate_amazon_3p_sales_and_traffic_innerbrightness_view WHERE report_date >= DATE '2026-05-01' AND report_date < DATE '2026-06-01' AND country_code = 'US' GROUP BY asin ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT 20;

question: 看 2026 年 5 月 Belli Welli AMS campaign 花费、广告销售额、订单数、ACoS 和 ROAS 排名
expected_sql: SELECT campaign_name, SUM(ams_spend) AS spend, SUM(ams_sales) AS ad_sales, SUM(ams_orders) AS ad_orders, SUM(ams_click) AS clicks, SUM(ams_impression) AS impressions, ROUND((SUM(ams_spend) / NULLIF(SUM(ams_sales), 0))::numeric, 4) AS acos, ROUND((SUM(ams_sales) / NULLIF(SUM(ams_spend), 0))::numeric, 4) AS roas FROM intermediate_amazon_ams_campaigns_belliwelli_view WHERE report_date >= DATE '2026-05-01' AND report_date < DATE '2026-06-01' AND country = 'US' GROUP BY campaign_name ORDER BY spend DESC LIMIT 20;

question: 找 2026 年 5 月 Belli Welli AMS 搜索词里点击不少但没有订单的浪费花费
expected_sql: SELECT search_term, SUM(ams_spend) AS spend, SUM(ams_click) AS clicks, SUM(ams_sales) AS ad_sales, SUM(ad_order) AS ad_orders FROM intermediate_amazon_ams_search_term_belliwelli_view WHERE report_date >= DATE '2026-05-01' AND report_date < DATE '2026-06-01' AND country = 'US' GROUP BY search_term HAVING SUM(ams_click) >= 5 AND SUM(ad_order) = 0 ORDER BY spend DESC LIMIT 30;

question: 看 2026 年 5 月 Inner brightness 广告商品 ASIN 的花费、销售和 ROAS

question: 算一下 2026 年 5 月 Belli Welli 每天 AMS 的 TACOS
expected_sql: WITH total_sales AS (SELECT report_date, SUM(ordered_revenue) AS total_sales FROM intermediate_amazon_3p_orders_belliwelli_view WHERE report_date >= DATE '2026-05-01' AND report_date < DATE '2026-06-01' AND country_code = 'US' GROUP BY report_date), ad_spend AS (SELECT report_date, SUM(ams_spend) AS spend FROM intermediate_amazon_ams_campaigns_belliwelli_view WHERE report_date >= DATE '2026-05-01' AND report_date < DATE '2026-06-01' AND country = 'US' GROUP BY report_date) SELECT s.report_date, s.total_sales, COALESCE(a.spend, 0) AS ad_spend, ROUND((COALESCE(a.spend, 0) / NULLIF(s.total_sales, 0))::numeric, 4) AS tacos FROM total_sales s LEFT JOIN ad_spend a ON a.report_date = s.report_date ORDER BY s.report_date;

question: 看 2026 年 5 月 Belli Welli DSP order funnel ROAS

question: 对比 2026 年 5 月 Belli Welli 和 Inner brightness 的订单销售额
expected_sql: WITH orders AS (SELECT 'belliwelli' AS brand_scope, report_date, ordered_revenue, ordered_units FROM intermediate_amazon_3p_orders_belliwelli_view WHERE report_date >= DATE '2026-05-01' AND report_date < DATE '2026-06-01' UNION ALL SELECT 'innerbrightness' AS brand_scope, report_date, ordered_revenue, ordered_units FROM intermediate_amazon_3p_orders_innerbrightness_view WHERE report_date >= DATE '2026-05-01' AND report_date < DATE '2026-06-01') SELECT brand_scope, SUM(ordered_revenue) AS sales, SUM(ordered_units) AS units FROM orders GROUP BY brand_scope ORDER BY sales DESC;
